# Data Model

## Persisted Entity

### `public.leads`

Defined in `supabase/migrations/20260729132615_create_leads_table.sql`.

- `id`: UUID primary key, generated by `gen_random_uuid()`.
- `name`: text, required.
- `company`: text, required.
- `need_type`: text, required; constrained to `baru`, `servis`, or `upgrade`.
- `capacity`: optional text.
- `location`: optional text.
- `message`: optional text.
- `phone`: optional text.
- `email`: optional text.
- `status`: text, required, default `baru`.
- `created_at`: timestamptz, default `now()`.

Indexes exist on `created_at DESC` and `status`.

## Relationships and Transactions

- No foreign keys or entity relationships are defined.
- The browser inserts one lead row through Supabase.
- An `AFTER INSERT` trigger asynchronously calls the notification Edge Function through `pg_net`; email delivery is not part of the insert transaction result.
- RLS permits anonymous/authenticated inserts and authenticated select/update/delete according to the migration policies.

## Key Entity Summary

- `leads`: prospective boiler survey, service, or upgrade request submitted by a visitor.
